English: Prayer Flag Post
A humble wooden pole adorned with fluttering prayer flags, serving as a focal point for communal prayers and blessings, even while on the move.
Stone Marker
A rough-hewn stone inscribed with sacred mantras, anchoring the faithful and marking a site of regular communal devotion.
Walled Shrine
A small, sturdy enclosure built from earth and stone, protecting sacred relics and providing a space for deeper spiritual gatherings.
Mani Pavilion
A timber pavilion housing prayer wheels and inscribed stones, encouraging constant devotion and attracting wandering monks and pilgrims.
Chanting Room
A dedicated space for communal chanting and meditation, constructed with timber and clay, where monks lead daily rituals.
Altar Hall
A spacious, ornately decorated tent or timber hall with a central altar, suitable for major religious festivals and public blessings.
Priests Chamber
Private quarters for respected priests and lamas, enabling more learned clergy to reside and guide the nomadic faithful.
Diviners Room
A secluded chamber for divination and ritual readings, enhancing spiritual guidance and unity within the clan.
Sanctified Sanctuary
A revered inner sanctum, richly adorned and ritually purified, drawing pilgrims from afar and strengthening the communitys spiritual core.
Tibetan Prayer Hall
A grand, multi-chambered hall of intricate woodwork and colorful murals, serving as a spiritual heart for the clan and a beacon of religious devotion.
